title: World Model Science: Self-Organized Criticality, Weak Chaos, and Metastable Belief Dynamics in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.17419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents must maintain task state across extended sequences of observations, actions, tool calls, and intermediate beliefs. We study these trajectories through three dynamical views: self-organized criticality, weak chaos, and metastable belief dynamics. Our framework aligns agent-implied states with benchmark-grounded states and measures stress accumulation, error avalanches, temporal dependence, local--global mismatch, bounded divergence, belief-basin transitions, and finite-size scaling under explicit null models. Across 22 experiments spanning controlled puzzles, tool use, embodied tasks, multi-hop retrieval, general-assistant reasoning, and Game of Life, we find that locally valid actions can persist after global state fidelity fails, stress can trigger abrupt collapse, error sequences exhibit long memory, dependency depth changes the propagation regime, and larger horizons support larger avalanches. translated_title: 世界模型科学：长时程LLM智能体中的自组织临界性、弱混沌与亚稳态信念动力学
translated_abstract: 长时程LLM智能体必须在扩展的观察、动作、工具调用和中间信念序列中维持任务状态。我们通过三种动力学视角研究这些轨迹：自组织临界性、弱混沌和亚稳态信念动力学。我们的框架将智能体隐含状态与基准验证状态对齐，并在明确的零模型下测量压力累积、错误雪崩、时间依赖性、局部-全局失配、有界发散、信念盆地转换和有限尺寸标度。在涵盖受控谜题、工具使用、具身任务、多跳检索、通用助手推理和生命游戏的22个实验中，我们发现局部有效的动作可以在全局状态保真度失效后持续存在，压力可以触发突然崩溃，错误序列表现出长记忆性，依赖深度会改变传播模式，更大的视界支持更大的雪崩。
tldr: 本文提出一个基于自组织临界性、弱混沌和亚稳态信念动力学的分析框架，用于刻画长时程LLM智能体的状态维持行为，通过22个实验揭示了局部有效动作可在全局状态失效后持续存在、压力累积可触发突然崩溃等关键动力学规律。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dynamical framework based on self-organized criticality, weak chaos, and metastable belief dynamics to characterize state maintenance in long-horizon LLM agents, revealing through 22 experiments that locally valid actions can persist after global state fidelity fails and stress accumulation can trigger abrupt collapse.
